subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your flight with AirTravelz. Your flight from New York to Los Angeles on May 15th at 9:00 AM has been successfully confirmed. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The AirTravelz Team
